newsitem.title: USA: Penederm gets FDA OK for antifungal cream.
newsitem.headline: Penederm gets FDA OK for antifungal cream.

text.p: Penederm Inc said Friday it had received clearance from the Food and Drug Administration to market Mentax, a cream used to treat ringworm and groin fungus.
Mentax received final market clearance in October 1996 to treat athlete's foot.
Promotion of the product for ringworm and groin fungus is expected to begin in the first quarter of 1997, Penederm said.
The company said it estimates the market for topical prescription antifungals to be about $350 milion a year in the United States.
